game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the heartwood tree.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the heartwood tree. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the heartwood tree using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The heartwood tree reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the heartwood tree is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mossy Creek'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
